title: Contextual fingerprint sentry and biased-sample attenuator for prompt-set regression gating
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: prompt-set regressions sometimes manifest as subtle shifts in semantic fingerprint distribution rather than simple metric drops (precision/recall). This PR adds a Contextual Fingerprint Sentry that fingerprints prompt outputs, computes cohort-level distribution drift, and attaches a soft gate to CI that attenuates noisy, biased sample sets before a hard fail.

What this does: implements a lightweight fingerprinting pipeline (embedding + locality-preserving sketch), a cohort drift detector with exponential decay baseline, and a biased-sample attenuator that reduces the influence of over-represented anchors when computing regression scores. The CI hook integrates with existing eval orchestration to produce a single quality signal (sentry_score) which can be configured as soft (warning) or hard (block).

Changes include: new eval hook code, unit + integration tests, CI configs for gated behavior, and docs for on-call triage and tuning knobs.

Design notes: the fingerprint is intentionally compact (64-byte sketch) to keep storage and comparison cheap. We use cosine-stable bucketing and a simple KS-like test augmented with time-decay to be robust to gradual drifts. The attenuator uses inverse-frequency weighting based on prompt fingerprint clusters.

Rollout plan: feature gated off by default. Roll to staged canary cohorts using the eval harness canary flag; monitor \"sentry_score\" and cohort-coverage metrics in the dashboard. If false positives appear, tune decay window and cluster granularity documented below.

Backward compatibility: existing eval hooks are unchanged unless the gate is enabled via CI config. No model artifacts changed.

Checklist:
- [x] core detection algorithm implementation
- [x] unit + integration tests
- [x] CI hook wiring and example config
- [x] docs + runbook stub
- [x] reviewer sign-offs

Related: ENG-2219 tracks follow-ups for replacing the sketch with an L2-consistent fingerprint store and for adding cross-run attribution.

review_comments: Ravi Singh (reviewer): Nice approach. Two requests: 1) add telemetry counters for fingerprint cluster sizes, 2) please comment the decay constant choices so SRE can tune later.
Maya Chen (author): Added telemetry counters and expanded comments on decay constants; left knobs in config with defaults. See amended commit.
Eve Hart (reviewer): Integration test looks flaky on the first run (timeout at 55s). Can we reduce the dependence on network timing in the integration harness?
Maya Chen (author): Reworked the test to use deterministic local data with a small mocked timer; CI reran and passed.
release_notes: Add configurable Contextual Fingerprint Sentry + biased-sample attenuator for prompt-set regression gating; opt-in CI hook to reduce noisy false positives and provide semantically-aware change signals.
migration_notes: No migration required. To enable the gate, add 'contextual_fingerprint_sentry: enabled: true' to ci/config/eval_gates.yaml and tune 'decay_window' and 'cluster_granularity' under the same section. See docs/ci_hooks/contextual_fingerprint_sentry.md for examples.
